process_observations: No competing dotnet build/test or testhost was observed immediately before or after the run. A dotnet --version process was present. No continuous process trace was captured.
samples: Ten warmups and ten requested measurement iterations per arm. BDN retained ten observations for Full, LatestOnly and native parallel, nine for native serial.
interpretation: LatestOnly mean 47.413 us versus native parallel 49.496 us; their confidence intervals overlap narrowly (48.923-48.983 us), so approximately matched rather than an established win. Full mean 79.995 us still loses to native parallel. LatestOnly allocation 86086 B exceeds native parallel 80292 B. Prior same-workload saved LatestOnly checkpoint was 1771.148 us; it is historical evidence, not a simultaneous control.
scope: Period 20, 10000 eighth-unit input prices. Builder retains startup outputs; native returns its packed completed windows. Full additionally owns OHLCV bars. Native parallel includes P-1 seed overlap. In-process BDN ShortRun with 100ms minimum iteration time. This does not qualify all inputs, periods, graph shapes or GPU performance.
